Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Nature & food

inland adjective and adverb

also interior, in the interior, toward the interior, inland seas

classical

Caes. BG 5.12.5: in mediterrāneīs regiōnibus, in maritimīs ferrum (Lewis & Short)

mediterrāneus, mediterrānea, mediterrāneum

declension

inland, away from the sea

As a noun, in mediterrāneō, in the interior (Plin. NH 3.10), and mediterrānea Galliae, the inland parts of Gaul (Liv. 21.31.2); both from Lewis & Short.

Other words

  • interior, interius — inner, inland

    declension · also used · classical · Traupman 204: inland seas, maria interiōra

  • intus — within, in the interior

    also used · classical · Traupman 204

Examples

  • in mediterrāneō

    in the interiorTraupman 204

  • oppida per continentem ā Tarentō

    towns inland from TarentumTraupman 204

See also coast, mainland.

SourcesJohn C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
